pages.text: §3Pit Kiln§r is the core facility for ancient pottery firing. It uses a dirt-walled pit structure, burning fuel through the fire mouth to produce high temperatures, combined with vents to control the kiln atmosphere, transforming greenware into different ceramic products.$(br2)This guide will walk you step by step through the construction and firing process of the pit kiln.

pages.title: Firing Principles
pages.text: The pit kiln operates in five stages:$(br)$(li)§4Stage 0§r: Basic structure - Place pit kiln block, §cno items can be placed without grate$(br)$(li)§4Stage 1§r: Install grate, load greenware$(br)$(li)§4Stage 2§r: Seal and heat - Temperature rises from room temp to 100℃$(br)$(li)§4Stage 3§r: High-temp firing - Formal firing stage$(br)$(li)§4Stage 4§r: Cooling - Natural cooling, products and ash automatically drop when complete

pages.title: Key Concepts
pages.text: $(li)§3Temperature§r: Determined by fuel, grate efficiency, and insulation grade, max 900℃ (1200℃ with blowpipe)$(br)$(li)§3Oxygen Content§r: Range -100 to +100, controlled by fire mouth and vents$(br)$(li)§3Oxidizing Atmosphere§r: High oxygen, suitable for redware$(br)$(li)§3Reducing Atmosphere§r: Low oxygen, suitable for gray ware and black ware$(br)$(li)§3Insulation Grade§r: Determined by surrounding dirt blocks (0-4 sides)

pages.title: Required Materials
pages.text: Building a complete pit kiln requires the following materials:$(br2)$(li)Pit kiln block ×1 (see crafting recipe in Building the Kiln chapter)$(br)$(li)Dirt blocks ×8 (for kiln body)$(br)$(li)Fire mouth block ×1$(br)$(li)Grate block ×1$(br)$(li)Kiln lid ×1$(br)$(li)Fire drill ×1 (ignition tool)$(br)$(li)Fuel (firewood, straw, rice husk char, etc.)$(br)$(li)Greenware items (crucible, mold, brick, blowpipe greenware, etc.)
§3Gray Crucible§r is one of the key successful products. Fired in a reducing atmosphere, it has high temperature resistance and is the basic tool for metal smelting.
§4Red Mold§r is fired in an oxidizing atmosphere, used for casting metal ingots and tools.
